description: Weekly grouped pull requests, digests pinned, nothing merged by itself, one-line commits the commit check accepts (docs/adr/0015-operations.md, docs/adr/0003-commit-convention.md). Never bumped: the embedding model (a change invalidates every vector and the eval's baseline) and the chat model's ID, pinned where no manager reads them. scripts/test_renovate.py checks this file.

customManagers.description: Digest-pinned images Renovate's own managers don't read: the Quadlet units' Image= lines, the backups' images (CI's list names local tags, which it skips, as CI follows deploy/backup/images), and the integration tests' Postgres and SeaweedFS.

packageRules.description: Go modules, one pull request a week.
The web app's and the Pages deploy's npm packages.
Actions, pinned to commit SHAs with their versions in comments.
Every image in one pull request: deploy/units_test.go needs compose, the units and the Go constants to change together (TestImagesMatchCompose).
No Postgres majors: pgvector's tag carries Postgres's major as -pgNN, which stays.
docling may bump, with what to run again.
prBodyNotes: Before merging docling: `make dev-up-docling` then `make pdf-record` (every PDF fixture's answers, the goldens and the verbatim report), and the ARM job by hand (`arm-real.yml`): docling's curve by page count against the 100-page cap (ADR 0013).

packageRules.description: Ollama may bump, with what to run again.
prBodyNotes: Before merging Ollama: the ARM job by hand (`arm-real.yml`), for its memory under the 2 GiB limit and its start log (`make prod-ollama-settings`) still showing the pinned context, one model and keep-alive.

packageRules.description: Pyodide may bump, with what to run again.
prBodyNotes: Before merging Pyodide: `make web-e2e`, whose runner tests run Python in it, and `make web-build` (its bundle budgets; Pyodide is precompressed under a versioned path).

packageRules.description: River may bump, with what to run again.
prBodyNotes: Before merging River: `make river-migration` for any new migration of River's, added through goose (ADR 0009), then `make test-integration`.
